product: Oral ARD-101, a gut-restricted bitter taste receptor TAS2R agonist that triggers local satiety hormone release to suppress hunger, was in Phase 3 for hyperphagia in Prader-Willi syndrome. ARD-201 is a fixed-dose combination of ARD-101 with a DPP-4 inhibitor aimed at obesity.
demand: No commercial demand: clinical-stage with zero revenue. Target demand is hyperphagia in Prader-Willi syndrome and hypothalamic obesity, both rare indications, with obesity as a longer-term opportunity.
pricing_power: None demonstrated. No approved product, no revenue and no disclosed pricing; ARD-101 also faces an already-approved PWS hyperphagia competitor, VYKAT XR, which weakens prospective pricing power.
competition: Soleno Therapeutics VYKAT XR, approved March 2025, already treats PWS hyperphagia; Rhythm Pharmaceuticals competes in rare metabolic disease; the obesity field is crowded with GLP-1 therapies from Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly.
team: Founder and CEO Tien Lee, M.D., leads the company; headcount is 28 after the June 2026 workforce reduction tied to the trial pause. Investor relations is outsourced to Argot Partners.
market_strategy: Resolve the FDA clinical hold through ongoing FDA discussions while unblinding and assessing HERO and OLE data in Q3 2026, then determine next steps for ARD-101 in PWS and options for ARD-201 in obesity.
bull: Cash of $73.9M funds operations into late 2027, and the Q3 2026 unblinded HERO and OLE assessment could still show ARD-101 efficacy and safety, allowing a redesigned pivotal PWS path.
bear: HERO and OLE were terminated in June 2026, the FDA imposed a full clinical hold on 2026-05-14, revenue is zero with roughly $15M quarterly burn, and BofA and Morgan Stanley rate it Sell.
falsifier: If the promised Q3 2026 unblinded HERO and OLE assessment, unreported as of 2026-09-25, shows ARD-101 efficacy and safety and the FDA lifts the hold, the bear case breaks.
web_what_changed: Last 90 days: June 2026 the company terminated Phase 3 HERO and OLE trials of ARD-101 and cut staff; 2026-08-11 Q2 results showed cash down to $73.9M from $91.2M, runway into late 2027; August-September wave of securities class actions; 2026-09-24 RBC maintained Hold, $6 target. Shares closed $5.47 on 2026-09-24.
web_not_known_yesterday: 2026-09-24: RBC Capital (Brian Abrahams) maintained Hold with a $6 target, and SueWallSt via PR Newswire repeated the 2026-10-13 lead-plaintiff deadline. No new clinical or regulatory disclosure; the promised Q3 2026 unblinded HERO and OLE assessment remains unreported as of 2026-09-25.
web_demand_price_volume_mix: Not applicable: there is no product revenue, so demand, price, volume and mix do not exist yet. Q2 2026 revenue was zero against R&D of $10.5M and G&A of $4.6M; all value now rests on ARD-101 efficacy and safety once HERO and OLE data are unblinded.
web_suppliers: Not named by the company. Risk factors cite dependence on third parties for manufacturing, shipping and production of drug product for clinical trials, implying CDMOs plus CROs and trial sites. With the IND on full clinical hold and HERO and OLE terminated, supplier constraints are currently minimal. No named supplier found.
web_customers: None today: clinical-stage, no approved drug, no revenue. Post-approval the would-be customers are a small Prader-Willi syndrome patient population, their families and US payers. No named customer and no disclosed customer concentration found.
web_who_loses: Soleno Therapeutics loses most, since its VYKAT XR (diazoxide choline extended-release) was FDA-approved in March 2025 as the first PWS hyperphagia treatment; Rhythm Pharmaceuticals also competes in rare metabolic disease. If ARD-201 works, obesity incumbents such as Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly face a gut-restricted oral alternative.
web_contradicting_evidence: Reversible cardiac findings at supra-protocol doses in a healthy-volunteer study triggered the 2026-03-02 HERO pause and a 56% share drop, the 2026-05-14 FDA full clinical hold, and the June 2026 termination of HERO and OLE. A class action alleges 99-percent gut-restricted and no-serious-adverse-events claims were misleading. BofA and Morgan Stanley rate it Sell.
web_if_management_right: The FDA lifts the clinical hold and unblinded HERO and OLE data support efficacy and safety, letting Aardvark redesign a pivotal PWS path; $73.9M of cash funds operations into late 2027, and ARD-201 could extend the platform into obesity.
web_if_management_wrong: ARD-101 is abandoned; with no revenue, 28 employees and roughly $15M quarterly burn, cash runs out before a new program. Expect further impairments, more securities litigation, possible delisting or reverse merger, and reliance on dilutive financing.
web_second_order_beneficiaries: If ARD-101 or ARD-201 succeed: contract manufacturers and CROs used for drug product and trials, clinical trial sites, Prader-Willi patient advocacy and diagnostic channels, DPP-4 inhibitor suppliers for the ARD-201 combination, and other gut-restricted oral metabolic developers.
